abstract: The synthesis, secretion and metabolism of progesterone have been examined in six human teratoma-derived cell lines with the objective of determining if they exhibit trophoblast-related or other specific steroidogenic functions. Progesterone was synthesised in nanogram amounts (per 10(6) cells/day) by the cell line SuSa, as measured by radioimmunoassay, and in lesser amounts by line LICR-LON HX-39. Lines Tera 1, Tera 2, T3B1 and PA-1 did not secrete detectable progesterone. All teratomas, however, metabolized added progesterone in microgram amounts (per 10(6) cells/day). In all cases the major metabolite was a polar compound, identified by reversed phase HPLC, TLC and GC-MS as 3 beta, 6 alpha-dihydroxy-5 alpha-pregnan-20-one. This pattern of metabolism was not confined to the teratomas as equivalent amounts of this polar metabolite were formed by cultures of adult differentiated human epithelial and fibroblast cells. When progesterone and its metabolites, separated by HPLC, were included in the estimation, the delta 5-3 beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase-isomerase activity of SuSa was equivalent to 47ng pregnenolone (3 beta-hydroxy-5-pregnen-20-one) metabolised/mg protein/day, that of HX-39 to 9ng/ml protein/day and those of other teratomas to less than 3.5ng/mg protein/day.
abstract_ja: ヒト奇形腫由来の6細胞株について、プロゲステロンの合成、分泌、代謝を検討した。これは、栄養膜関連のステロイド産生機能やその他の特異的なステロイド産生機能を持つかを確かめるためである。SuSa株は細胞あたり毎日ナノグラム量のプロゲステロンを合成し、HX-39株はそれより少ない量を合成した。Tera 1、Tera 2、T3B1、PA-1 の各株では検出可能なプロゲステロン分泌はみられなかった。しかし、すべての奇形腫株はプロゲステロンをマイクログラム量代謝した。全株で主要な代謝物は極性の高い化合物で、逆相HPLC、TLC、GC-MSにより 3β,6α-ジヒドロキシ-5α-プレグナン-20-オンと同定された。同様の代謝物は成人の分化したヒト上皮細胞および線維芽細胞の培養でも同等量生じ、この代謝様式は奇形腫に限られなかった。HPLCで分離したプロゲステロンおよび代謝物を考慮した場合、SuSa株の Δ5-3β-ヒドロキシステロイド脱水素酵素-異性化酵素活性は、タンパク質1mgあたり1日47ngのプレグネノロン相当であった。HX-39株は9ng、他の奇形腫株は3.5ng未満であった。
